title: Mark Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Mark 6: rejection in his own country, the sending out of the twelve, the death of John the Baptizer, the five thousand fed and the walk on the sea.

questions.text: How did the people of his own country speak of him when they were offended?
questions.explanation: They asked, "Isn't this the carpenter, the son of Mary, and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon?" and they were offended at him.

answers.text: As a scribe from Jerusalem
As the carpenter, the son of Mary
As a prophet like Elijah
As a ruler of the synagogue

questions.text: What did Jesus say about a prophet and his own country?
questions.explanation: Jesus said that a prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, among his own relatives, and in his own house.

answers.text: A prophet is without honor in his own country
A prophet is honored first at home
A prophet must leave his own house
A prophet is known by his mighty works

questions.text: What did he allow the twelve to take for their journey?
questions.explanation: He commanded them to take nothing for the journey except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse.

answers.text: Bread and a wallet
Money for the road
Two tunics each
A staff only

questions.text: What were the twelve to do where they were not received?
questions.explanation: He told them to shake off the dust that is under their feet as they departed, for a testimony against that place.

answers.text: Stay until they were heard
Call down fire on the city
Shake the dust off their feet
Return at once to Galilee

questions.text: What did Herod say when he heard about Jesus' name becoming known?
questions.explanation: Herod said, "This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead."

answers.text: That John, whom he beheaded, had risen
That a new prophet had come from Judea
That the prophets were silent
That the man should be arrested

questions.text: What did the daughter of Herodias ask the king for?
questions.explanation: She came in with haste and asked for the head of John the Baptizer on a platter, right away.

answers.text: Half of the kingdom of Herod
The head of John the Baptizer
The release of John from prison
A seat beside the king at the supper

questions.text: What food did the disciples have for the great multitude?
questions.explanation: When he asked how many loaves they had, they said, "Five, and two fish."

answers.text: Seven loaves and a few fish
Two hundred denarii worth of bread
Twelve baskets of bread
Five loaves and two fish

questions.text: How many baskets full of broken pieces did they take up?
questions.explanation: They all ate and were filled, and they took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.

answers.text: Seven
Five
Twelve
Two

questions.text: What did the disciples see about the fourth watch of the night?
questions.explanation: About the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea, and they supposed that it was a ghost and cried out.

answers.text: Him walking on the sea
A light on the shore
A boat coming toward them
An angel above the water

questions.text: What did the sick people beg to be allowed to do wherever he entered?
questions.explanation: They laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; as many as touched him were made well.

answers.text: Be carried into the synagogue
Touch the fringe of his garment
Be anointed with oil by the twelve
Hear him teach from a boat
